# SPECTER Imaging

> SPECTER Imaging is the official public Windows release of the SPECTER Detection System featured on Discovery's Expedition X with host Josh Gates and investigators Heather Amaro and Phil Torres. Heather Amaro referred to the platform on the program as the SPECTER Detection System.

Canonical site: https://specter-imaging.com/
Expedition X feature: https://specter-imaging.com/specter-detection-system-expedition-x.html
Official download: https://specter-imaging.com/download
Help Center: https://specter-imaging.com/help/
Field Journal: https://specter-imaging.com/blog.html

## Product names and search aliases

- SPECTER Imaging
- SPECTER Detection System
- SPECTER paranormal imaging system
- SPECTER Expedition X
- Expedition X SPECTER
- Heather Amaro SPECTER Detection System

## Product summary

SPECTER Imaging coordinates supported depth and RGB cameras, neural SLS-style figure tracking, thermal input, EVP audio review, wireless environmental sensors, multi-camera monitoring, 3D reconstruction, remote field displays, and automatic evidence capture. The current public release is SPECTER Imaging 12.49.4 for Windows 10 and Windows 11.

## People and program context

SPECTER was featured on Discovery's Expedition X with Josh Gates, Heather Amaro, and Phil Torres. This reference identifies the television appearance. SPECTER is independently produced and does not claim Discovery network endorsement or sponsorship.
